'''Vepp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the ship was [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]], Vepp and his superior [[Salen]] were trapped in the engineering deck with the rest of the engineering crew. A group was attempting to repel the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and Imperial invaders, and Vepp suggested that they reroute the power generators instead of depressurizing the engineering section.

==Behind the scenes==
Vepp was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Republic Flashpoint ''Esseles''.
